shared_elements: linear incised relief on a slab surface
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing shallow incised relief combining profile human figures with rows or blocks of script-like signs, which is the strongest but still fairly generic correspondence. A shows a specific symmetrical scheme of two seated figures facing each other across a laden offering table with horizontal text lines beneath, whereas B's carving is confined to a narrow vertical strip of stacked, blocky sign-and-figure units with no facing pair, no offering table and no horizontal text register, and the drawing conventions (elongated smooth outlines vs. dense angular compartments) differ markedly.
